title: post auth register with valid and invalid data
description: Test the POST /auth/register endpoint for successful employee registration with valid data, validation errors with invalid email or mismatched confirm_password, and conflict error when email already exists.

title: post auth login with valid and invalid credentials
description: Test the POST /auth/login endpoint for successful login with valid credentials, unauthorized error with invalid credentials, and unauthorized error for terminated user accounts.

title: get profile with valid and invalid tokens
description: Test the GET /profile endpoint to retrieve the authenticated user's profile with a valid Bearer token and verify 401 Unauthorized response when token is missing or invalid.

title: post employees with role based access and validation
description: Test the POST /employees endpoint for creating new employee records with valid data and HR_MANAGER or ADMIN roles, and verify 403 Forbidden for insufficient roles and 400 Bad Request for missing or malformed data.

title: get employees list with pagination and role permissions
description: Test the GET /employees endpoint with pagination parameters for HR_MANAGER or ADMIN roles to retrieve employee lists, and verify 403 Forbidden for users without sufficient permissions.

title: get employee detail by id with role based access
description: Test the GET /employees/:id endpoint to retrieve a single employee's details with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN roles and verify access control.

title: patch employees update with valid data and roles
description: Test the PATCH /employees/:id endpoint to update employee records with valid fields and HR_MANAGER or ADMIN roles, ensuring successful update and role-based access control.

title: delete employees soft delete with role based access
description: Test the DELETE /employees/:id endpoint to change employee status to TERMINATED with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN roles and verify access restrictions.

title: post leave requests with valid and invalid data
description: Test the POST /leave-requests endpoint for submitting leave requests with valid dates and leave types, and verify 400 Bad Request for invalid date ranges or missing required fields.

title: post payrolls process with role and validation checks
description: Test the POST /payrolls/process endpoint for processing monthly payrolls with valid pay period and HR_MANAGER role, and verify 403 Forbidden for unauthorized roles and 400 Bad Request for missing pay period fields.
